images.prompt:
Original hand-painted festive watercolour stationery illustration on subtly textured warm-white paper, with transparent layered pigment, gentle dry-brush marks and fine selective charcoal-pencil detail rather than bold outlines. Use moderate focal detail, generous breathing room, soft wintery light, muted evergreen, sage, cranberry, warm brown, cream and blue-grey hues, delicate cool shadows and a warm nostalgic handmade mood. Characters, where present, are softly naturalistic and storybook-like, with rounded forms, subtle faces and restrained gestures; preserve clear hierarchy and home-print-friendly tonal contrast.

SHARED STYLE (style only): illustration style: Hand-painted festive watercolour stationery with original botanical and winter storytelling motifs, balancing a refined handmade feel with clear card-front readability.; line weight: Very fine, selective charcoal-pencil or ink accents; no heavy outlines.; line quality: Gently irregular, organic and hand-rendered, used sparingly to define small details.; detail level: Moderate detail concentrated in one clear focal illustration, with secondary marks kept airy and restrained for reliable home printing.; character language: Softly naturalistic storybook characters with rounded silhouettes, subtle facial features and understated expressive gestures.; background density: Predominantly clean warm-white space; any scenic detail is contained, lightly layered and allowed to recede behind the focal point.; palette: Muted heritage Christmas palette of evergreen, sage, olive, cranberry, brick red, warm brown, cream, soft grey and frosty blue-grey; red used as a restrained accent.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Transparent layered washes with gentle wet-on-dry modelling, soft cool winter shadows and occasional warm accents; never glossy or digitally airbrushed.; texture: Fine cold-pressed paper grain, mottled watercolour pigment, delicate dry-brush foliage marks and subtle hand-painted variation.; mood: Warm, nostalgic, peaceful and quietly celebratory.; print considerations: Designed for an A4 or US Letter folded-card layout with light warm backgrounds, broad safe margins and no essential detail near folds or trim lines. Keep dark pigment coverage moderate and preserve sufficient tonal separation so fine details reproduce clearly on home printers..

REFERENCE CHARACTERISTICS (general only, never copied): palette: Earthy, vintage-leaning and cohesive: evergreen and sage greens, cranberry or brick reds, natural kraft/wood browns, cream, warm grey, and occasional subdued blue-grey. Bright red acts as a sparing focal accent.; linework: Reference 01 has delicate, irregular painted edges with only occasional fine pen-like detail; reference 02 uses very fine, soft dark outlines around tiny icons and figures; reference 03 relies mainly on painterly edges and extremely fine naturalistic detail rather than bold contour lines.; texture: Visible paper-like and watercolour texture is suggested through mottled washes, uneven pigment, fine foliage marks and, in the winter scene, detailed fur, knit, woodgrain and snow texture. The actual reference images also show physical card stock and styled-photo textures, which need not be reproduced in printable artwork.; composition density: The set ranges from low-density, centred or wreath-framed motifs with generous margins (reference 01), to an airy structured grid of small motifs and captions (reference 02), to one dense square narrative illustration held inside a wide clean border (reference 03).; background: The designed card faces use clean off-white paper backgrounds. Reference 03 contains a complex snowy outdoor scene only within its framed central illustration. The surrounding photographic tabletop props, black mobile-screen areas and checkout interface are presentation imagery, not elements of the card designs.; mood: Warm, gentle, nostalgic and intimate. The first two feel handmade and affectionate; the third is cosy, storybook-like and quietly wintry..
